findings.passage: Here are the facts: a majority of signatures within the board’s sample were valid. The number of signatures submitted in total went above and beyond what was required. People have been loud and clear that non-citizens voting in our elections is an issue that should be decided on – not one that should be stifled time and again by bureaucratic games.
findings.note: Statement issued in his name after the Board of State Canvassers denied a ballot proposal that would require voters to prove they are U.S. citizens. He criticises the denial and says non-citizen voting is an issue voters should decide.
